newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco do Brasil H1 results due out Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: Banco do Brasil H1 results due out Aug 18.

text.p: Brazilian government bank Banco do Brasil is due to announce its first half results on August 18, a bank spokeswoman said Tuesday.
After heavy losses in 1995 and 1996, the bank posted a 155.29 million reais net profit between January and May.
But first half earnings are likely to be lower than market analysts had expected after Banco do Brasil said it would raise provisions to cover pension-related debts.
In a statement sent to the local stock exchanges Tuesday, the bank said it would raise to 8.7 billion reais the provision in the first half from the 6.8 billion reais it had previously announced.
Banco do Brasil said it made that decision after its pension fund Previ failed to reach an agreement with the fund's participants that would allow the bank to cut pension-related debts.
